patterns.usage_note: The purpose-of-motion に: it takes either a noun of activity (買い物に, 散歩に) or a verb's masu-stem (見に, 迎えに), and the main clause is a verb of movement — 行く, 来る, 帰る, 出かける, 寄る — which casual speech may leave unsaid (「ちょっと買い物に。」). Because the slot is the masu-stem, no object may follow the pattern; whatever is being fetched or watched goes before it (雑誌を買いに行く). にゃ is the casual contraction of には, so it adds the contrastive shading of は to the same purpose phrase and belongs to relaxed or regional speech. Do not confuse it with the homographic にゃ from なければ (行[い]かにゃならん), which contracts a conditional rather than には.

examples.ruby: 今日[きょう]は昼[ひる]から友達[ともだち]と映画[えいが]を見[み]に行[い]く。
examples.english: This afternoon I'm going to see a movie with a friend.

examples.ruby: 母[はは]が空港[くうこう]まで迎[むか]えに来[き]てくれた。
examples.english: My mother came all the way to the airport to pick me up.

examples.ruby: スーパーは近[ちか]いから、車[くるま]で買[か]い物[もの]にゃ行[い]かないよ。
examples.english: The supermarket's close by, so it's not like I drive out to do the shopping.
